title: Lesson 16: Mary Had a Little Lamb

segments.text: Lesson 16
segments.translation: 第16课

segments.text: Mary had a little lamb
segments.translation: 玛丽有一只小羊羔

segments.text: Was Dimitri right to apologize to his neighbour? Why not?
segments.translation: 迪米特里向他的邻居道歉对吗？为什么不对？

segments.text: Mary and her husband Dimitri lived in the tiny village of Perachora in southern Greece.
segments.translation: 玛丽和丈夫迪米特里住在希腊南部一个叫佩拉霍拉的小村庄里。

segments.text: One of Mary's prize possessions was a little white lamb which her husband had given her.
segments.translation: 玛丽最珍贵的财产之一就是丈夫送给她的一只白色小羊羔。

segments.text: She kept it tied to a tree in a field during the day and went to fetch it every evening.
segments.translation: 白天，她把羊羔拴在田地里的一棵树上，每天傍晚去把它牵回家。

segments.text: One evening, however the lamb was missing.
segments.translation: 可是，有一天傍晚，小羊羔不见了。

segments.text: The rope had been cut, so it was obvious that the lamb had been stolen.
segments.translation: 绳子被割断了，很明显，羊羔是被偷走了。

segments.text: When Dimitri came in from the fields, his wife told him what had happened.
segments.translation: 当迪米特里从田里回来时，妻子把发生的事情告诉了他。

segments.text: Dimitri at once set out to find the thief.
segments.translation: 迪米特里立即出发去寻找小偷。

segments.text: He knew it would not prove difficult in such a small village.
segments.translation: 他知道在这样一个村子，找小偷并不困难。

segments.text: After telling several of his friends about the theft, Dimitri found out that his neighbour, Aleko, had suddenly acquired a new lamb.
segments.translation: 在把失窃的事告诉了几个朋友后，迪米特里得知他的邻居阿莱科突然得到了一只新羊羔。

segments.text: Dimitri immediately went to Aleko's house and angrily accused him of stealing the lamb.
segments.translation: 迪米特里立即来到阿莱科家，愤怒地指责他偷了羊羔。

segments.text: He told him he had better return it or he would call the police.
segments.translation: 他告诉他最好把羊羔还回来，否则他就报警。

segments.text: Aleko denied taking it and led Dimitri into his backyard.
segments.translation: 阿莱科否认偷了羊，并领迪米特里来到他的后院。

segments.text: It was true that he had just bought a lamb he explained, but his lamb was black.
segments.translation: 他解释说，他确实刚买了一只羊羔，但他的羊羔是黑色的。

segments.text: Ashamed of having acted so rashly, Dimitri apologized to Aleko for having accused him.
segments.translation: 迪米特里为自己行为鲁莽感到羞愧，于是就指责阿莱科一事向他道歉。

segments.text: While they were talking it began to rain and Dimitri stayed in Aleko's house until the rain stopped.
segments.translation: 就在他们说话时，下起雨来，迪米特里在阿莱科家呆到雨停。

segments.text: When he went outside half an hour later, he was astonished to find that the little black lamb was almost white.
segments.translation: 半小时后，当他走到外面时，他吃惊地发现，那只黑色的小羊羔几乎变白了。

segments.text: Its wool, which had been dyed black, had been washed clean by the rain!
segments.translation: 它的羊毛被染成了黑色，却被雨水冲洗干净了！
